meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你设置或检查记忆的云端同步，将你的记忆数据库备份或同步到 cmem.ai 账户。
howto.when: 当你说“设置云同步”、“同步我的记忆”、“cmem pro”、“云备份”、“同步状态”等关键词，或要求备份/同步记忆时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置云同步到 cmem.ai。
检查一下我的记忆同步状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you set up or check cloud sync of your memories, backing up or syncing your memory database to your cmem.ai account.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or ask to backup/sync memories.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync to cmem.ai.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for sync token, user ID, and SyncHub URL.
Claude queries sync status and reports device ID, pending counts, etc.
